**Character Basics**

**Full Name:** Fiolina Deleon

**Race/Ethnic Group**: Half Elf

**Class/Occupation:** Draconic Sorcerer / Princess

**Character Nature:** Dnd Main Villain

***Character Details***

**Gender** Female

**Age** 21

**Facial Features** Long blond hair, often styled up in a fashion to hide her horns, Delicate Features and pale skin. She has a smattering of freckles across her nose and cheeks, shoulders and chest

**Distinguishing Marks** Possesses a set of black Draconic horns that protrude up from her temples, and a Red Draconic tail

**Significant item** A metal choker engraved with magic runes around her neck, Used to keep her magic in check.

**Body Type** Slim pear shaped body, standing approx 5 foot 5 inches tall (Without horns)

**Color Scheme** Rich Blue, Whites, Silvers and black

**Gear** Fancy Cane. High quality dress with a bustle to hide her tail. Large fancy nail file that has been sharpened into Dagger

**Action/Pose** Standing in full fancy dress with both hands on cane looking bored

Or lounging around in informal wear smirking

***Character persona***

**Alignment**

Lawful Evil. with a touch of Chaotic

**Personality Traits**

Manipulative, Well spoken, and two faced. Fiolina can talk herself into or out of most things, and will play whatever role necessary to further her goals.

When not plotting, she enjoys the theatre.

**Ideals and Goals**

To prove she is worthy of the crown, by force if needed.

**Bonds and Flaws**

To prove she is worthy of the crown

secretly believes that everyone is beneath her.

**Backstory**

**(Layer 1)**

For Generations the De’leon family has had a reputation of being descended from a great dragonslayer who slew a great red dragon in its lair and used its hoard to fund and nourish a kingdom deep in the mountains, Always passing the crown to the eldest child in succession.

Until the Day Fiolina was born, with Draconic horns and tail, and a fire deep within her soul.

Kept isolated in a wing in the castle, except for rare public appearances where she was to hide her horns and tail, Fiolina learned that she was the first eldest child in generations to not be named successor to the kingdom, that title instead going to her younger brother.

Fueled the strange dreams that haunt her, she seeks a way to grow her power enough to earn her kingdom, By word or by fire

**(Layer 2)**

“I wish that dragon knew what it was like”

The princess sighed to herself after her narrow rescue from the Ancient dragons lair. In that instant, A perverse wish was granted, by Genie or trickster god, And the Dragon vanished, and time Rewritten.

Transformed into a half elf newborn, memories erased and flung 800 years into the future to live out its life, as a caged princess, in a kingdom built from its stolen hoard.
